title: SupportMatrix
description: codespec-support-matrix/1: per cir/1 feature and per language, whether reading and writing it is supported. Written by codespec-docs to website/data/support-matrix.json from schemas/cir-1.features.json, each adapter's --describe manifest and the conformance reports; read by the SupportMatrix component of the site. Every language's read and write map holds one cell for every feature id in features.

cir.description: The model version the feature list belongs to.

features.description: One row per feature, in the order of schemas/cir-1.features.json.

languages.description: One read and one write column per language, in display order.

op.description: The operator string, for a feature of family operator only.

description.description: The feature's description, copied from schemas/cir-1.features.json; backticks mark code.

case.description: The directory under conformance/cases whose subject is this feature, or null where no case exists.

name.description: The language as shown in the column header.

cell.description: A cell is its state as a bare string. Only a cell that carries a note is an object, {"state", "note"}; a writer never emits an object without a note.

note.description: Why the cell has its state, in one sentence: what a refusal leaves out, or the first difference a failing report found.

state.description: verified: claimed in the manifest and the conformance report passes. claimed: in the manifest, no report. failing: claimed, and the report fails. refused: not claimed. n/a: not applicable to this role, so never claimable and left out of coverage (every reader cell of a fact feature, which is writer-only). none: no adapter for that role.
